verdict.rationale: Pilot's docs say it integrates with payments (Stripe) and payroll (Gusto) tools and offers real-time account data in its portal. A customer reports that bank and card integrations handle transaction classification with no founder effort. However, no first-party documentation describes bank connections or how integration activity syncs automatically into the ledger. missing for 10: first-party documentation of bank-account connections, documented mechanics of automatic sync from integrations into the ledger, and detail on which payroll and payments systems are supported beyond the named examples.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: We integrate with hundreds of tools like Bill.com, Stripe, and Gusto.
stay up to date with real time account data directly in the portal
their integrations with my banks, expensify, credit cards, etc handle all of the transaction classification
